name: autonomous-sdlc-command-center
description: A local-first, safety-gated control plane for repository intelligence, incident triage, delivery readiness, gated writes with rollback, and engineering risk review.

interface.longDescription: Maps repositories, diagnoses failures, measures release readiness, scans for leaked secrets, scores delivery risk, and applies approval-gated changes with backup, rollback, and a tamper-evident audit log.
defaultPrompt: Map this repository and identify the highest-impact delivery risks.
Diagnose this CI failure with evidence and a minimal verification plan.
Assess this change for security, reliability, and release readiness.
